comments.author: hoobastank
comments.body_html:
Hey Firstly, love the mod, it’s great to get working Prestige in SPT!

Is it possible to also modify the items that are allowed to be transferred at each prestige level with this mod? (Like streamer items for Collector)

I’m trying to figure out if I could use it as a sort of Zero-to-Hero mini Rogue-lite for SPT and slowly be able to keep more item at each level.

comments.author: ZloyMolodoy
comments.body_html:
Hey, sorry for the long wait - I don’t check here that often :)

Unfortunately the mod can’t change the lists of transferable items.

It only overrides prestige requirements:

character level money skills hideout quests (remove them / tweak quest start)

As for using it as a Zero-to-Hero / mini Rogue-lite where you keep more items at each prestige level - that’s not supported right now either. That would need a separate feature to patch the transfer/reward item lists per prestige. Right now the mod only changes how you unlock prestige, not what you take with you after it.

comments.author: ZloyMolodoy
comments.body_html: Unfortunately, I’m not going to fix this mod, I did it to make it easier to get prestige, but just a couple of hours later, the creator of another mod adjusted the cost of getting them, as in live tarkov.
